h1: The 8 Best Room Dividers on Wheels of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Room Dividers on Wheels: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 8 best room dividers on wheels for 2026, from single panels to 6-panel and soundproof models, with specs and who each suits.
summary: The SUNALLY 4-panel is our top pick for most rooms, balancing fabric, stability and price. The HOMSCREENER 6-panel covers big floor plans, and the HOMSCREENER soundproof 3-panel is the home office choice. The MAYOLIAH is the cheapest single panel.
intro: A wheeled divider is only useful if it stays put. Casters that do not lock, or a narrow base, turn a privacy screen into a rolling hazard. Check the lock mechanism and foot width before panel count.
We ranked eight dividers by size, panel count, caster design and fabric weight, based on listing specs.

products.name: SUNALLY 4-Panel Room Divider with Lockable Wheels
products.verdict: The best balance of fabric, stability and price.
products.description:
This divider is 88 inches wide and 72 tall with four panels, 240gsm polyester over powder-coated steel, four silent lockable PE wheels per panel and extended widened feet.

It ranks first because widened feet add stability that narrow-base rivals lack. It sits in the $50-100 bucket.

Buy it for a bedroom or studio. Skip it if you need six panels.
products.skipIf: You need a very wide span.

products.name: HOMSCREENER 4-Panel Room Divider on Wheels
products.verdict: Double hinges that bend around irregular layouts.
products.description:
The divider is 88 inches wide and 71.3 tall, with 240gsm polyester, ten self-locking PE casters, a 17.7 inch metal base and double hinges.

It ranks second since its longest base in the group helps stability, but it stays just behind the SUNALLY on listed wheel design.

It suits awkward rooms. Skip it if you want a flat wall of fabric.

products.name: GOFLAME 4-Panel Rolling Room Divider
products.verdict: Folds compact and bends into L, W or C shapes.
products.description:
The GOFLAME is 89 inches wide and 68 tall, with polyester and metal, ten lockable 360-degree swivel wheels with individual brakes and L, W and C shapes.

It ranks third because it is a bit shorter at 68 inches than the picks above.

It suits renters who fold it away. Skip it if privacy height matters.

products.name: HOMSCREENER 6-Panel Room Divider on Wheels
products.verdict: A 132 inch wide divider for open floor plans.
products.description:
This divider is 132 inches wide and 72 tall with six panels, 240gsm polyester over steel tube, eight self-lockable wheels and a scratch-resistant, rust-proof frame.

It ranks fourth because eight wheels across six panels leaves fewer locks per panel. It is in the $100-200 bucket.

It suits large rooms. Skip it for small spaces.

products.name: Giantex 6-Panel Room Divider with Lockable Casters
products.verdict: Fourteen lockable casters, the most in this ranking.
products.description:
The Giantex is 132 inches wide and 68 tall with six panels, polyester over powder-coated metal and 14 lockable universal casters of 1.5 inch diameter.

It ranks fifth since small casters can struggle on thick carpet, though quantity helps stability.

It suits buyers who prioritize lock count. Skip it for carpeted rooms.

products.name: Kokorona 6-Panel Room Divider with Lockable Wheels
products.verdict: Gap-cover strips remove sightlines at the hinges.
products.description:
The Kokorona is 119 inches wide and 70 tall, with 180gsm polyester over iron, seven sets of lockable wheels, large support feet and gap-cover strips.

It ranks sixth because 180gsm fabric is thinner than the 240gsm models above.

It suits buyers wanting full privacy. Skip it if fabric weight matters.

products.name: HOMSCREENER 3-Panel Soundproof Room Divider on Wheels
products.verdict: A tackable, noise-absorbing panel for home offices.
products.description:
The three-panel divider is 72 inches wide and 66 tall, with ECO PET and polyester fabric, over 85 percent listed noise absorption, 12 self-locking wheels and zipper connections with a tackable surface.

It ranks seventh since it costs the most, in the $200-500 bucket, and spans only 72 inches.

It suits offices and studios. Skip it if you need width.

products.name: MAYOLIAH Single Large Panel Rolling Room Divider
products.verdict: The cheapest option, a single non-see-through panel.
products.description:
The MAYOLIAH is a single panel of 71 by 75 inches, with fabric over iron, four lockable wheels, a no-gap design with six fasteners and a waterproof, non-see-through finish.

It ranks last because one panel cannot bend or wrap a corner. It sits in the $25-50 bucket.

It suits one-spot privacy. Skip it if you need flexible layouts.

methodology.title: Stability
methodology.description: Base width, foot design and caster count.

whatMatters.detail: Rolling dividers can drift. Locks keep them still once placed. Look for individual brakes or self-locking wheels.
A wide base resists tipping. Narrow feet make tall screens unsteady. Check base length in the specs.
Heavier fabric hides silhouettes better. 240gsm is thicker than 180gsm. Check gsm on the listing.
More panels span more floor but are harder to store. Measure the gap first.
Small casters roll badly on carpet. Hard floors suit them. Note your floor before ordering.

faq.a: Standard fabric ones block sight, not sound. Only the HOMSCREENER soundproof lists absorption.
Hard PE wheels can mark soft floors. Check wheel material.
Panel units fold. The single MAYOLIAH does not.
Wide bases help. Lock wheels when parked.

faq.q: How do I clean the fabric?
faq.a: Wipe with a damp cloth. Waterproof fabrics are easier.
Larger casters roll better. Small 1.5 inch wheels struggle.

finalTake: The SUNALLY 4-panel is the best all-round pick. Large rooms suit the HOMSCREENER 6-panel, and noisy home offices benefit from the soundproof 3-panel. Lock the wheels once positioned.
